+import importlib.util
+import sys
+
+# Load the function without importing the whole fastapi package to avoid pydantic issues
+spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("fastapi.security.utils", "/workspace/fastapi/security/utils.py")
+utils = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+spec.loader.exec_module(utils)
+get_authorization_scheme_param = utils.get_authorization_scheme_param
+
+def test_get_authorization_scheme_param():
+    # Test case 1: Single space (correct)
+    assert get_authorization_scheme_param("Bearer xxx") == ("Bearer", "xxx")
+
+    # Test case 2: Multiple spaces
+    assert get_authorization_scheme_param("Bearer   xxx") == ("Bearer", "xxx")
+
+    # Test case 3: Trailing whitespace
+    assert get_authorization_scheme_param("Bearer xxx ") == ("Bearer", "xxx")
+
+    # Test case 4: Leading whitespace in param (already covered by case 2)
+    assert get_authorization_scheme_param("Bearer  xxx") == ("Bearer", "xxx")
+
+    # Test case 5: No param
+    assert get_authorization_scheme_param("Bearer") == ("Bearer", "")
+    assert get_authorization_scheme_param("Bearer ") == ("Bearer", "")
+
+    # Test case 6: Empty or None
+    assert get_authorization_scheme_param("") == ("", "")
+    assert get_authorization_scheme_param(None) == ("", "")
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    try:
+        test_get_authorization_scheme_param()
+        print("All tests passed!")
+    except AssertionError as e:
+        print(f"Test failed!")
+        raise e
